verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal consultation and visa services, not a software platform. A sandbox test environment isolated from production data is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no API or developer surface that would make the axis apply: the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
